Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about German bullion laws, taxation, and karat valuation.

What is the price of 21k gold per gram in Germany today?
The price of 21k gold per gram in Germany today hovers around 64.27 EUR. 21k is widely preferred among Middle Eastern communities in Germany for traditional jewelry.
Is buying gold bars VAT-free in Germany?
Yes, under German tax law, investment gold (24k bullion bars and certified gold coins) is completely exempt from 19% VAT (MwSt).
What is the difference between gold buy and sell price (Spread) in Germany?
The buying price is what you pay to dealers or banks, while the selling (melt/scrap) price is what dealers pay when buying from you. Bullion bars have the lowest spread.
Can I travel with gold through German airports?
Yes, but under EU customs rules, cash or precious metals exceeding 10,000 EUR per person must be officially declared upon entering or leaving the EU.
